mcp.title: MCP access
mcp.intro: Connect AI assistants to the Buryad MCP server for Russian↔Buryad translation. Tools: translate_word (dictionary lookup), translate_text (AI translation), lookup_word (word card) and pronounce (pronunciation audio).

ai.title: AI
ai.subtitle: Tools for working with the Buryat language through AI agents.
ai.mcpWhat: MCP is a way to connect an AI assistant (Claude, Cursor, etc.) to external tools. Through our MCP server the assistant translates ru↔bur using the buryads dictionary and AI.

tools.translate_text: AI translation of a phrase or text (counts toward the daily AI limit)
tools.lookup_word: word card: meanings, description, image, audio link
tools.pronounce: audio link for pronunciation; audio exists for Buryat words only
tools.corpus_examples: real bur↔ru sentence examples from the corpus, with source
tools.list_packs: your word packs and public ones
tools.get_pack: words of a pack: translations, image, audio
tools.quiz: vocabulary quiz, optionally limited to one pack
tools.word_of_the_day: word of the day with translations and examples
tools.favorites_add: add a history entry to favorites
tools.create_pack: create a pack from Buryat words (words missing from the dictionary are not added)
tools.check_text: Buryat text check: dictionary plus AI remarks (may be wrong)
tools.review_grade: grade how well you recalled a word and schedule the next review
tools.suggest_translation: suggest a translation for the dictionary (added only after review)
tools.decompose_word: morphological analysis of a Buryat word form: lemma, part of speech, case or verb form (beta, may be inaccurate)
tools.build_word: builds a word form: case (singular), verb tense and person, participles, converbs (beta, may be inaccurate)

ai.limitTexts: 20 texts per hour (AI translation also counts toward the daily AI limit)
ai.scopeHint: --scope user — the server is available in all projects; without it, only in the current folder
